dedupe_keys.name: nemo morphology data survey path delfland 2012 2016

description: TU Delft provides non-interpolated coastal survey-path observations from its NeMo project. The source identifies marine and aeolian cross-shore morphology over 17 kilometres alongshore. Its custom interval runs from 25 February 2012 to 7 September 2016. Coverage: 2012-02-25T00:00:00Z/2016-09-07T00:00:00Z. Access: public native metadata describes the identified resource. Licence: 4TU General Terms of Use. Current file access and cost are unknown. Provider-specific reuse conditions have not been read where general terms apply. Caveats: Native bi-monthly wording does not settle an exact regular sampling frequency. The actual survey paths remain distinct from combined and interpolated transect products. Related resources are separately identified in the native collection. The native Sand Motor collection identifies a coastal-protection nourishment and monitoring programme. Simulation use concerns its coastal geometry and sediment or hydrodynamic calibration.
